name: Scream
description: (Tag:mental)(Tag:tool)Dubbed "Military Music Dream", Scream is a flute-like Teigu whose songs manipulate listeners' emotions toward anger, calm, courage, joy, or sorrow. Effects are resisted by strong willpower or dispelled by pain. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people with sufficient musical talent.
